youtube.title: Why Big Ships Have a Giant Bulb Underwater 🚢 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Large ships have a rounded protrusion below the waterline at the front called a bulbous bow. It creates its own wave that is timed to cancel the wave the hull makes as it pushes through water. Less wave energy means less drag, so the ship burns less fuel.
